snippet.title: HYPER GROOVE AX | Release Date Announcement
snippet.description:
Introducing HYPER GROOVE AX, a twin-track beat matching rhythm game built for Panic's Playdate. Match beats while switching between two different note highways, keeping the crowd hyped on both while aiming for the highest score possible.

Featuring nine tracks and available in both English and Japanese, HYPER GROOVE AX gives you the dopamine rush of classic rhythm games like Rock Band, Dance Dance Revolution, and Amplitude all in a portable form so you can groove on the go.

HYPER GROOVE AX releases on October 27th 2026.

--
